title: Mass Effect fans petition Canada to save BioWare 🍁
subject: masseffect
description:
Should Canada step in to save BioWare? 👇

House of Commons petition e-7898, sponsored by NDP MP Don Davies, opened November 4, 2026. It asks the Government of Canada to give BioWare the capital to become independent from Electronic Arts along with its IP. EA announced BioWare's closure in October. The petition is open to Canadian citizens and residents until March 4, 2027.

Sources: House of Commons e-petition e-7898, VGC (Nov 4, 2026), Kotaku (Nov 4, 2026)
Game footage © Electronic Arts.

scenes.text: Canada's Parliament now has a petition to save BioWare.
Petition e-7898 opened on the House of Commons website on November 4, sponsored by NDP MP Don Davies.
It asks Ottawa to fund BioWare's independence from Electronic Arts, games included.
EA announced in October that it was closing the Edmonton studio, and Mass Effect: Universe was cancelled.
Only Canadians can sign, and it already passed the 500 signatures needed for a government response.
EA still owns BioWare and Mass Effect. The petition closes March 4, 2027.
